metadata.description: Name of the environment that can be used as part of naming resource convention
Id of the user or app to assign application roles
Existing Azure OpenAI endpoint (if useExistingOpenAI is true)

resources.name: [format('{0}/{1}', format('cosmos-{0}{1}', parameters('environmentName'), uniqueString(resourceGroup().id)), guid(resourceId('Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts', format('cosmos-{0}{1}', parameters('environmentName'), uniqueString(resourceGroup().id))), parameters('principalId'), variables('cosmosRoleDefinitionId')))]

properties.roleDefinitionId: [format('/{0}/resourceGroups/{1}/providers/Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts/{2}/sqlRoleDefinitions/{3}', subscription().id, resourceGroup().name, format('cosmos-{0}{1}', parameters('environmentName'), uniqueString(resourceGroup().id)), variables('cosmosRoleDefinitionId'))]
